messages:
elena: FYI partner (Acme) ready to sign up for Azure marketplace listing. Need to decide packaging and operational handoff. Quick sync?

jasper: short answer: do private-offer trial (30d, usage cap) + plan to convert to meter-on-consumption public SKU after success. avoids invoicing complexity initially.

rachel: legal question: for a private offer we still need an explicit marketplace EULA snippet and a data-collection disclosure. @legal-bot please confirm required fields.

legal-bot: checklist: 1) trial duration in plain language, 2) termination & refunds policy, 3) export control clause, 4) telemetry/PII disclosure, 5) contact for support/escalation. Will produce a short template paragraph.

elena: ops: what do you need to publish? ARM templates? image? publisher tenant?

jasper: we are shipping a container-backed managed plan (not a VM image). Needed items: publisher tenant id, offer alias, plan ids, a manifest.json (minimal), and a webhook endpoint for consumption notifications. We'll also need an analytics forwarding endpoint to track conversion.

ops-bot: publishing checklist (starter):
- PublisherID (GUID)
- OfferAlias (slug)
- plans: [trial-30d] with cap & eligibility
- manifest URL: s3://redwood-marketplace/azure/acme/manifest-v1.json
- webhook: https://hooks.internal/re/marketplace/azure/consume (stub)
- RBAC: who has publisher portal access?

rachel: legal draft for end-user facing copy: "Try Redwood Inference via this private Azure offer: 30-day free trial with up to 100,000 tokens per month. Trial access may be terminated for misuse. By using this offer you agree to Redwood's marketplace terms and our privacy policy." I'll refine and post to drive.

elena: can someone paste the minimal manifest snippet (we'll hand to partner and to the marketplace team)?

jasper: minimal manifest example (paste in channel):
```json
{"offerAlias":"acme-redwood-trial","plans":[{"id":"trial-30d","displayName":"30 Day Trial","eligibility":"private_only","usageCap":"100000"}],"supportContact":"partners@redwood.ai","manifestVersion":"1.0"}
```

ops-bot: note: in Azure private offers, billing can be handled via meter events or partner-managed. We recommend letting Azure report consumption events and forward them to your webhook. Make sure signature validation (X-Marketplace-Signature) is implemented.

elena: action items: jasper=confirm manifest fields + push manifest to s3 by COB, rachel=post legal copy + policy deltas by EOD, ops=create webhook stub + test harness. I'll schedule partner handoff for tomorrow 9am PT.

jasper: pushing manifest to s3 now: s3://redwood-marketplace/azure/acme/manifest-v1.json and creating offerAlias in the portal. will share OfferId once available.

rachel: legal note: partner asked about telemetry: we only capture consumption metadata (offerId, planId, usage) — no raw prompts are stored. adding privacy wording to the template.

elena: perfect. last question: do we want auto-upgrade from trial to paid if partner adds card? thinking no — keep manual conversion so we can sanity-check usage & billing mapping.

jasper: agree, manual conversion. keeps partner experience controlled.

elena: thanks all. will post a one-pager and next steps in this thread after the handoff. :white_check_mark:
